items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane has a knee injury and is questionable to return (mid-game update).
items.why: Knee injury during game vs Chiefs.
items.implication: Monitor return; handcuff/backup snaps if out rest of way.
items.opportunity: If OUT remainder, backup RB carries/targets spike.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is on the field in Brazil testing his hamstring; said to look good as team mulls decision. Earlier: true pre-game GTD but team not counting on him playing.
items.why: Pregame workout on soggy field; possible pitch count 20-30 plays if active.
items.implication: Late swap risk; Bateman/Andrews upside if OUT. ETR projecting OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, targets to Bateman/Andrews; if limited IN, reduced routes/snaps.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder, Q) expected/active vs Bengals. WR Michael Pittman (foot, Q) expected to play. Rico Dowdle OUT.
items.why: Shoulder limited practices; Dowdle toe OUT opens backfield.
items.implication: Warren RB1 workload; Pittman back in WR corps.
items.opportunity: Warren carries/targets/redzone with Dowdle out; high snap share.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected to play and officially active vs Chargers. Keon Coleman also active.
items.why: Shoulder (AC joint); extra days after TNF; expected per source.
items.implication: Moore back in lineup, possibly limited; reverse any stale handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: Full or near routes if healthy enough; Bills pass game intact.

items.text: Panthers WR Xavier Legette OUT; Jalen Coker ACTIVE/up. Tyjae Spears up for Titans.
items.why: Ankle for Coker good; Legette knee out.
items.opportunity: Coker targets/snaps up with Legette out.

items.text: With AD Mitchell inactive, Jets WRs: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain. Expect TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount.
items.why: Mitchell out confirms earlier projection; depth chart shift.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 volume; DFS opportunity on secondary pieces.
items.opportunity: Wilson target monopoly; Sadiq routes increase.

items.text: Projecting Zay Flowers OUT (late Bateman/Andrews DFS swap). Moore IN but limited; Mitchell OUT. Warren/Evans/Bowers projected IN despite Q.
items.why: Team not counting on Flowers; data-driven projs pending 1pm clarity (updated later).
items.implication: Avoid Flowers or have swap ready; lean Warren/Bowers/Evans.
items.opportunity: Bateman upside; Moore limited routes possible.
items.conflict: Workout looks good may flip to limited IN.

items.text: TE Brock Bowers (knee, Q) expected to play/IN vs Saints. Projecting in despite Q; first career game post-surgery.
items.why: Limited practices, planned Friday rest; no TE elevation.
items.implication: Must-start TE if active; Mayer handcuff reverse.
items.opportunity: Immediate high routes/targets as featured TE.

items.text: Weekend summary: GTD Flowers (not counting), Spears (hopeful). Expected: Warren, Pittman, Barkley, Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson, Bagent. Projecting Flowers OUT, Moore limited, Mitchell out.
items.implication: Start expected players; Flowers late decision, projs OUT for Bateman swap.

items.text: Mike Evans (hip), Saquon Barkley, Devonta Smith expected to play. Evans plans to play per sources.
items.why: Beat reports; Evans plans to play.
items.implication: Start with confidence; full or near roles.
items.opportunity: Barkley/Smith Eagles backfield/WR intact; Evans volume.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring, 3-4 week injury per sources (w/ Rapoport). Hoping to beat timeline as quick healer. Ruled out Week 3.
items.why: Grade 2 strain; scar tissue pain noted.
items.implication: Bagent or other starter multi-week; Bears pass catchers downgraded ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream; Odunze/Moore/etc volume may shift.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight week (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% target share last week with Collins out; Colts allow TE yards.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor run D; high prop.

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% targets both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.

LOVE Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs). LOVE Dalton Schultz @IND (28% tgt share w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most TE yds). LOVE Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ tgts).
items.opportunity: Olave volume; Schultz TE1 role; Watson RZ.

items.text: HATE Rhamondre Stevenson @JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs). HATE Travis Etienne vs LV (49% touches, 38% 3rd down). HATE Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FP to WRs, low team total).
10 Facts: Post-fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched Stevenson 16-5. Dalton Schultz 28% tgt share/30% routes w/ Collins out. Drake London 20+ PPR/35% tgts/97 yds w/ Penix (12 games).
items.implication: Henderson rising; Schultz TE stream; London smash w/ Penix.
items.opportunity: Henderson pass-pro limits but volume up; Schultz TE1; London high share.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson > Henderson short-term.
